finalText:
**Build's clean.** Exit 0, 0 errors.

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

- `resolveRetries` in [options.js](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Threw `TypeError` on `undefined.toFixed`.
- `isBackoffEnabled` in [retryPolicy.js](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) threw on `undefined` flags. New config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, so it now treats that as disabled.

The rest was deprecation noise (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, `punycode`, etc), left as-is.
